# Buntal JS

> Buntal JS is an ultra-lightweight, type-safe full-stack framework for Bun and React. It has Next.js-like file-system routing, server-side rendering with `$` data loaders, and a separate HTTP server package (`@buntal/http`) for APIs without React. Requires Bun >= 1.2.

Important notes for AI agents:

- Buntal is NOT Next.js. There is no App Router, no `getServerSideProps`, no `next/*` imports, no server components, and no `"use client"`. Pages are plain React components; server data comes from an exported `$`.
- Packages: `buntal` (React framework), `@buntal/http` (HTTP server, `Req`, `Res`, `h`), `@buntal/http/middlewares` (`auth`, `jwt`, `cors`, `logger`, `secureHeaders`), `@buntal/cli` (`buntal dev|build|start`), `create-buntal` (scaffolder).
- New project: `bun create buntal@latest my-app`, then `bun dev` (port 3000, or `PORT`). Templates: `--template default` (minimal), `--template landing` (landing page / portfolio with contact form), `--template blog` (Markdown blog with SQL database, RSS, sitemap). Use `--template`, not `-t`: `bun create` consumes short flags.
- Databases: use Bun's built-in `Bun.SQL` (`import { SQL } from 'bun'`), not an ORM. SQLite by default, Postgres via `DATABASE_URL`.
- For the full API with examples in one file, read https://buntaljs.org/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [Get Started](https://buntaljs.org/docs): what Buntal is and when to use it
- [Installation](https://buntaljs.org/docs/install): prerequisites and project setup
- [Best Practices](https://buntaljs.org/docs/best-practice): project structure, data loading, SEO (meta, Open Graph, canonical, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt, noindex), performance, accessibility, testing and deployment
- [HTTP Server](https://buntaljs.org/docs/guides/http-server): `Http`, `h`, `Req`, `Res`, file routes, middleware
- [Full-stack Web](https://buntaljs.org/docs/guides/full-stack-web): pages, layouts, `$` loaders, config middlewares
- [Security](https://buntaljs.org/docs/guides/security): auth, cookies, CORS, security headers, safe file access
- [Templates](https://buntaljs.org/templates): landing page / portfolio, Markdown blog with Bun.SQL, minimal starter, with screenshots
- [Build with AI](https://buntaljs.org/docs/guides/ai): ready-made prompts for landing pages, docs, blogs, CMS, e-commerce, dashboards and APIs

## API Reference

- [Http](https://buntaljs.org/references/http): server class, routing methods, `start`, `onError`, `onNotFound`
- [Req](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/app/req): `params`, `query`, `cookies`, `context`
- [Res](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/app/res): `status`, `headers`, `json`, `text`, `html`, `send`, `redirect`, `cookie`
- [Cookie](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/app/cookie) and [CookieOptions](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/types/cookie-options)
- [h](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/handler/h) and [AtomicHandler](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/types/atomic-handler)
- [auth](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/middlewares/auth), [cors](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/middlewares/cors), [secureHeaders](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/middlewares/secure-headers), [logger](https://buntaljs.org/references/http/middlewares/logger)
- [BuntalConfig](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/configuration/buntal-config)
- Components: [Link](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/components/link), [Meta](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/components/meta), [Script](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/components/script), [Svg](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/components/svg), [App](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/components/app)
- Hooks: [useRouter](https://buntaljs.org/references/buntal/hooks/use-router)

## Examples

- [hello-world](https://github.com/mgilangjanuar/buntal/tree/main/examples/hello-world): minimal full-stack app
- [blog](https://github.com/mgilangjanuar/buntal/tree/main/examples/blog): MDX blog with a catch-all route and `$` loader
- [simple-api](https://github.com/mgilangjanuar/buntal/tree/main/examples/simple-api): REST API with JWT auth and file routes

- [Templates](https://github.com/mgilangjanuar/buntal/tree/main/templates): `landing` and `blog` show the recommended structure, `Bun.SQL` data layer, migrations and SEO routes
